name: Python
description: High-level programming language emphasizing code readability, versatility for backend development, data science, automation, and AI.
benchmarks: Decorators, generators, asyncio, OOP, type hinting, packaging.

name: FastAPI
description: Modern, high-performance web framework for building APIs with Python 3.8+ based on standard Python type hints and Starlette/Pydantic.
benchmarks: Dependency injection, Pydantic validation, async/await handlers, OpenAPI specs, background tasks.

name: JavaScript
description: Core web programming language for interactive client-side browser logic and asynchronous network interactions.
benchmarks: ES6+ syntax, Promises/async-await, DOM manipulation, Fetch API, event loop, closures.

name: HTML5 & CSS3
description: Semantic markup and styling foundations for building responsive, accessible, cross-browser web interfaces.
benchmarks: Semantic tags, Flexbox, CSS Grid, media queries, CSS custom properties, WCAG compliance.

name: SQL & Relational Databases
description: Structured Query Language for modeling, querying, indexing, and optimizing relational databases like SQLite and PostgreSQL.
benchmarks: Complex joins, indexing strategies, transactions (ACID), schema migrations, query optimization.

name: Docker
description: Platform for developing, shipping, and running applications in lightweight, isolated containers.
benchmarks: Multi-stage builds, container networking, volume mounting, compose orchestration, image optimization.

name: Machine Learning
description: Algorithms and statistical models that computer systems use to perform tasks without explicit instructions.
benchmarks: Classification, regression, cross-validation, feature engineering, hyperparameter tuning, model evaluation (ROC-AUC, F1).

name: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
description: Architectural pattern combining semantic vector search and information retrieval with generative language models for grounded, factual answers.
benchmarks: Document chunking, dense embeddings, vector indexing, cosine similarity, prompt augmentation, reranking.

name: Git & Version Control
description: Distributed version control system for tracking changes in source code during software development.
benchmarks: Branching, rebasing, merge conflict resolution, interactive rebase, pull requests, semantic commit messages.

name: RESTful API Design
description: Architectural style for designing networked applications leveraging standard HTTP methods, status codes, and JSON serialization.
benchmarks: Statelessness, resource naming conventions, idempotent operations, pagination, rate limiting, error responses.

name: Problem Solving
description: Ability to identify complex problems, deconstruct root causes, evaluate trade-offs, and implement effective technical solutions.
benchmarks: Algorithmic thinking, debugging complex bugs, root cause analysis (RCA), trade-off evaluation.

name: Communication & Collaboration
description: Clear verbal and written articulation of architectural concepts, documentation writing, and empathetic teamwork.
benchmarks: Code review etiquette, design doc authoring, communicating technical debt to non-technical partners.

name: Adaptability & Continuous Learning
description: Agility in embracing new technologies, adjusting to evolving project requirements, and self-directed skill acquisition.
benchmarks: Quick ramp-up on new tools, willingness to experiment, incorporating feedback constructively.
